values.note: First come, first served; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site.

booking.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('you may not pay ahead for camping on a future date'; 'Upon arrival at the campground, choose an unoccupied campsite'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included; Devilfish Lake began charging in 2026. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Starting in 2026, all forest campgrounds that previously did not charge a camping fee will charge $17 per night'; affected campgrounds 'Grand Portage State Forest: Devilfish Lake, Esther Lake, McFarland'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site') + DNR facility cmp00061 (camping fee 1), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on Devilfish Lake in the Arrowhead north of Grand Marais, with a dock and lake access. No garbage service: pack out all trash. No gas motors on the lake. Managed by Judge C.R. Magney State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00061 read: 5 primitive sites, vault toilet, dock, no garbage; free -> $17 (DNR lists Devilfish Lake among the campgrounds that began charging in 2026). Lakeview kept (spur ~25 m from the shore behind trees). Phone and website fixes.
flags: FEES changed 0 -> 17 (derived value from old note prose): the DNR state forest fee page lists Devilfish Lake among the campgrounds that 'previously did not charge a camping fee' and 'will charge $17 per night' starting 2026; the DNR facility record has camping fee 1.

WATERFRONT lakeview kept. On Esri imagery the campground is a few gravel spurs in mixed forest south of the lake; the east spur ends near 47.9919,-90.0944, about 25 m from the shore through a band of trees, and the west branch leads to the dock and lake access at about 47.9917,-90.0958. No pad on open ground at the water (no lakefront); a view through the trees from the east spur is plausible but no photo was found. The 5 sites cannot be numbered.
PHONE 218-387-3039 -> 218-387-6300: the DNR facility record names the manager as Judge C.R. Magney State Park, 218-387-6300. 218-387-3039 appears on no page read.

Pin 47.99050,-90.09560 is about 60 m from the DNR facility point 47.991057,-90.095529 at the access loop; no move. Season not stated by the DNR; left unset. No alerts on the forest (alert: ohv_trails/forest_roads empty).
